prompt: Kevin notices the entry "`recursion no;`" in the BIND 9 configuration file. What does this directive achieve?
choices: It disables zone transfers to all secondary servers.
It restricts the DNS server to authoritative answers only, and prevents it from performing recursive queries for clients.
It stops the server from caching any records.
It forces the server to use forwarders for every query.
explanation: The `recursion no;` directive means the DNS server will only provide answers for zones for which it is authoritative and will not perform recursive queries on behalf of clients.
